fieldissues.issue: The short repeats a title saying all 1,500 recipients were terrorists and received pardons, while the packet says the clemency included both pardons and commutations and recipients had different convictions.

“Mass Terrorist Pardoning and Violence Incentivization” states unverified legal and causal conclusions; “terrorist releases” and “systematic terrorism reward” are not neutral subjects.
